note:
Implementation choices for --related.

- Argument: --related accepts space-separated UUIDs (nargs='*'), validated by uuid.UUID(); invalid values fail fast with exit code 5. Considered comma-separated but space-separated reads more naturally on the CLI and matches argparse convention.
- Schema position: 'related' lands between 'commit' and 'note' so the prose stays at the bottom of the JSON for human-readability. Migration script inserts it in this position for existing notes.
- No bidirectional links: when note B says related=[A], note A is NOT auto-updated to back-reference B. Bidirectional linking would require rewriting existing JSON files at record time, which conflicts with the immutability of recorded notes (notes are append-only). Consumers that want a reverse index can build one by scanning the corpus.
- No existence check: we don't verify that the referenced UUID exists in the local notes corpus, because cross-repo references are an explicit use case (the user mentioned "across the codebase") and a referenced note may live in a different WHY_NOTES_DIR.
